title: Complete Erdős #501: Independent Sets for Outer Measure Families (Work in Progress)

problemStatement.formal: \{A_x\}_{x} \text{ bounded},\ \lambda^*(A_x)<1 \implies \exists \text{ infinite } I \text{ independent (}x\notin A_y\ \forall x,y\in I)\,?
problemStatement.plain: For bounded sets A_x with outer measure < 1, must infinite independent sets exist? Answer depends on set-theoretic axioms!
whyMatters: Whether infinite independent sets exist is independent of ZFC — a striking set-theoretic dichotomy.
